briefdescription.para: Allocates peripheral parent IDs for a mux.

detaileddescription.para: This function allocates peripheral parents for the mux based on type of the parent.

parameterdescription.para: Type of group parents belong to.

simplesect.para: Here the bits in group type indicate the type of parent. Specific bit corresponds to specific parent as in Bit 0 indicates type for parent 1, Bit 1 for parent 2 and Bit 2 for parent 3. If the bit is set then the parent corresponds to PLL, else the parent corresponds to divider.
